name: measuretwice-conformance
description: Shared cross-language conformance fixtures for the portable contracts in contracts/v0. Every wrapper runs every group through the Rust core. The fixtures are mandatory for the TypeScript SDK and for the later Python SDK.

groups.runner: Validate each file as one definition artifact. Compare canonical content and hashes with the hashing group.
Reject each raw artifact with the stated reason code and field path, before any evaluator runs.
Validate each input object against its root schema in the Rust core. Materialize the described oversized inputs as stated in their notes.
Canonicalize each value in the Rust core and compare the canonical text and the digest. The record shape follows contracts/v0/hashing.schema.json.
Assess each record with the Rust exact rules and compare the outcome and, for maxLength, the code point count.
Reject each text or byte string with the stated reason code. No hash of invalid content is published.
Convert each TypeBox source with the documented conversion, validate it, and compare the canonical content and the definition-domain hash with the named definition file.
Serialize and parse each value and compare the canonical form. Reject each authoring kind with nonportable_value before serialization.
Validate each assessment against the assessment contract and the using list of its check.
Build one report for each table row and compare the aggregate outcome. Check each sample record against the run report contract.
Validate each artifact, verify each self-hash, and check each compatibility pairing before execution.
Replay each trace through the wrapper scheduler with the fake clock and compare every expected check record, the aggregate outcome, the completion status, and the rejected events.
